_what: A person's saved subject decisions, synced daily from kb_curation by kb/_sync_subject_decisions.py so the builders honor them (kb/subject_decisions.py). decisions: the Subjects page's saves (SUBJ:<college>|<code>|<band>, subject_decision; band credit, whole or nc:<noncredit category slug>). statewide: the Local subjects List's filings (_SUBJ_DISC::<CODE>, subject_discipline_confirm), the MQ discipline a person filed a code under. courses: the Subjects panel's course moves (CRS:<college>|<code>|<course number>, course_subject_decision), one person's common code for one course, read by the re-mint's gate (kb/_mid_readiness.py) and never by a nightly mint. who is the person a filing names, a procedure's cohort id, or 'a reviewer'; no email is kept.
_rule: A person's save wins over the catalog, the subject map and any recommendation (r-subject-save-path-kb-curation-sam-2026-11-22). Precedence for a college's code and band: its decision, then a statewide filing, then the subject map, then a recommendation. A credit decision reads the code's credit courses only; whole reads a code COCI lists no course under; nc:<slug> reads the code's noncredit courses in that COCI noncredit category only.
